(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A speaker comprising a permanent magnet (2), and a coil (8) positioned around the permanent magnet and attached to a membrane (10), wherein the membrane (10) comprises an elastomer of thickness less than 0.3mm and with a Young's modulus __of at least 10MPa and below__ 100MPa.

(Currently Amended) Claim 2: A speaker as claimed in claim 1, wherein the elastomer (10) comprises a silicone __compound__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: A method of manufacturing a speaker, comprising: forming a membrane (10) from an elastomer, wherein the membrane has thickness less than 0.3mm and a Young's modulus __of at least 10MPa and below__ 100MPa; attaching a coil (8) to the membrane; and assembling the speaker by suspending the membrane (10), such that the coil (8) is positioned around a permanent magnet (2).
